components.css: :host{--desk:#e6ebf1;--paper:#ffffff;--paper-2:#f4f7fb;--ink:#15171c;--ink-2:#4a5160;--rule:#9aa7b9;--hair:#d4dbe5;--head:#d9e3f0;--act:#24467a;--act-ink:#ffffff;--up:#c1121f;--down:#0b7339;--bar:#15171c;--bar-ink:#ffffff;--fs-l:24px;--fs-m:15px;--fs-s:13px;--sans:'Noto Sans TC',system-ui,-apple-system,'PingFang TC','Microsoft JhengHei',sans-serif;--num:'Source Sans 3','Noto Sans TC',system-ui,sans-serif;--kai:'LXGW WenKai TC','BiauKai','DFKai-SB','Kaiti TC',serif}.ds-detail{border-top:1px solid var(--rule);padding:12px 12px 14px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font:400 var(--fs-m)/1.5 var(--sans);max-width:520px}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-detail{animation:ds-open .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}}@keyframes ds-open{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-4px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}.ds-dh{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px}.ds-dh h3{margin:0;font:700 var(--fs-m)/1.4 var(--sans)}.code{margin-left:6px;font:400 var(--fs-s) var(--num);color:var(--ink-2)}.ds-x{min-width:44px;min-height:44px;border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--paper);color:var(--act);cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center}.ds-x:hover{background:var(--paper-2)}.ds-x:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--act);outline-offset:2px}.ds-facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));margin:10px 0 0;border:1px solid var(--rule)}.ds-facts>div{border-right:1px solid var(--hair)}.ds-facts>div:last-child{border-right:0}.ds-facts dt{padding:2px 8px;background:var(--head);font-size:var(--fs-s);color:var(--ink-2)}.ds-facts dd{margin:0;padding:4px 8px 6px;font:700 var(--fs-m) var(--num)}

narrative.overview:
The page is one formal notice per trading day, the kind a listed company files on 公開資訊觀測站 and a government office writes as 公文. A white sheet lies on a cool blue-grey desk. An ink-reversed title bar names it, a ruled header grid gives the date, the notice number and the comparison, and the body runs in fixed form rows: 主旨 (one sentence saying what the manager bought and sold), 說明 (numbered items: 一、買進 and 二、賣出 as two hard halves, 三、行情, 四、誰拉、誰拖), 附表 (一、持股一覽 as a cell grid, 二、持股明細 as a sortable table) and 備註. The structure is the form, not decoration.

Hierarchy comes from three type sizes, weight, reversal and 1px rules. Only three hues carry meaning: navy marks what can be pressed, and red and green mark price direction. Buy and sell state is never a colour. It is drawn as line form in ink, the way a clerk would mark a printed table. The page is dense and calm on purpose: everything is visible, and the only thing that opens is a stock's own history, in place under the row or cell that was tapped.

The confirmed rejections are the broker-app card dashboard and the dark quote terminal. The dark theme stays a dimmed document, not a terminal.
keyCharacteristics: A white document sheet on a blue-grey desk, square corners, 1px blue-grey rules everywhere.
Ink-reversed title bar; pale-blue header rows on every table and fact grid.
Kai-face form labels (主旨 / 說明 / 附表 / 備註 and the 一、二、 numerals); Noto Sans TC for everything else, Source Sans 3 tabular figures for numbers.
Navy on pressable things only; red up and green down on price change only.
Buy / sell state as line form: double = new, filled = add, dashed = cut, outlined and struck = out.
A stock's history opens in place, one at a time, never in a modal.

rules.name: The Pressable Navy Rule
rules.body: Navy appears only on something that responds to a tap: a link, key, select, stock name, fold button or the focus ring. Never use it for headings, labels, figures or decoration.

rules.name: The Quote Colour Rule
rules.body: Red and green mean price direction (red up, green down) and nothing else, always with a sign and a ▲ / ▼ arrow. A buy or a sell is never red or green.

rules.name: The Line Form Rule
rules.body: Buy and sell state is drawn in ink as a frame: a double line means new (新增), a filled ink tag or a solid 2px frame means add (加碼), a dashed line means cut (減碼), and an outlined, struck-through tag means out (剔除). Sold rows grey to secondary ink with the name struck through.

rules.name: The Three Sizes Rule
rules.body: Only 24, 15 and 13px exist. Rank comes from weight, reversal and rules, never from a fourth size.

rules.name: The Form Voice Rule
rules.body: Kai is reserved for what the form itself prints: the four row labels, the item numerals and the 備註 markers. Content is never set in Kai, and a new label needs its characters added to the Kai subset.

rules.name: The Ruled Depth Rule
rules.body: Inside the sheet, depth is a rule or a header tint, never a shadow, card or gradient. A group gets a 1px rule frame and a pale-blue head row.

dos: Do keep every section a labelled form row: Kai label left, content right, a strong rule between rows.
Do put a pale-blue head row on every table and fact grid, and frame it with a 1px strong rule.
Do write a price change with a sign and a ▲ / ▼ arrow as well as the quote colour.
Do mark a new buy / sell state with one of the four line forms in ink.
Do open a stock's history in place under what was tapped, one at a time, with its state in the hash.
Do keep every tap target at least 44px and every text / ground pair at least 4.5:1 in both themes.
donts: Don't use navy on anything that cannot be pressed.
Don't colour a buy or a sell red or green, or a price change anything but red up / green down.
Don't add a fourth type size or set content in the Kai face.
Don't round corners, add cards, shadows or gradients inside the sheet.
Don't open a stock's history in a modal, a drawer or a new page.
Don't turn the dark theme into a quote terminal; it is the same document, dimmed.
